comment: A brush whose size follows the pen's speed paints the straight stroke of 750 document pixels, a pen at 1.5 px/ms, five times: frame paced as thirty moves, the same under a load of 33 ms a frame, at a pen's 240 reports a second under the load, at the rate on the engine's clock under the load, and once more that way with reports that carry no time of their own, as the app's pen sends them. The size is the speed sensor alone on a 150 px radius, so a pen read at 1.5 px/ms lays dabs of 7.5 px and one read at 10.7, the figure for the loaded rate stroke, lays dabs of 54. Each stroke runs inside a speed trace, and the canvas is exported whole so the five bands can be cropped and compared texel for texel.
